meta_description: Lady Magnolia Decorating provides professional interior and exterior painting across Newcastle. Expert finishes, competitive rates. Call for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: Expert finishes for your home or business. We transform spaces with meticulous preparation, quality paint, and attention to detail.
services_heading: Complete Painting and Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From interior feature walls to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Transform any room with expert interior painting. We prepare surfaces thoroughly, apply premium finishes, and protect your furniture and flooring. Colours matched to your taste.

services.title: Exterior Painting and Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paints keep your home protected. We work in all conditions and tackle preparation, priming, and topcoats to last.

services.title: Feature Walls and Accent Colours
services.desc: Create visual impact with a bold feature wall or sophisticated accent colour. We help you choose the right shade and execute the finish perfectly.

services.title: Woodwork and Door Painting
services.desc: Refresh skirting boards, doors, window frames, and banisters. We sand, prime, and apply durable paint finishes that resist chipping and weathering.

services.title: Wallpapering and Wall Preparation
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging or removal, plus surface preparation. We ensure a smooth, long-lasting finish whether you're choosing pattern or plain paint.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Shops, offices, and rental properties need reliable, fast turnaround painting. We work around your business schedule and deliver professional results.

about_pullquote: I started Lady Magnolia because shoddy paint jobs frustrated me. Now I do it right.
about_para_1: Lady Magnolia Decorating has served Newcastle and the surrounding area for over 12 years. What began as a single painter's commitment to honest, careful work has grown into a trusted local name. We've painted hundreds of homes and businesses—from Victorian terraces to modern new-builds—always with the same focus: proper preparation, quality materials, and finishes that last.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we listen, we're transparent about costs, and we show up on time. We don't rush jobs or cut corners on prep work—the difference shows in a paint finish that stays beautiful for years. Your home or business deserves the same care we'd give our own.

reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the hallway and living room repainted after years of scuffs and marks. The team moved furniture carefully, protected everything, and the finish is brilliant. They even touched up a couple of spots I'd missed without charging extra. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Martin T.

reviews.text: We were nervous about our entire exterior being painted, but from day one they explained what they'd do and why. Took their time with prep, used decent paint, and the house looks completely refreshed. Fair price too. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Came out for a quote same week, got the work done without fuss. Very professional, clean, no mess left behind. The skirting boards and doors look brand new. Much better than the last lot we tried.
reviews.author: Robert L.
